public_rationale: There is evidence of dissatisfaction with early features and growing general AI distrust. There is also favorable evidence about Apple Intelligence. None establishes that poor performance caused millions to become substantially more opposed to AI, much less that it was the principal cause. The narrower findings do not justify a mixed verdict on the larger causal claim.
limitations: The principal favorable evidence is a news report of a private research note.
The evidence concerns US respondents; the claim specifies no geography.
Product dissatisfaction is not a measure of becoming opposed to AI.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that poor Apple Intelligence performance made at least two million people substantially more opposed to AI generally.
Radicalized is read as a substantial adverse attitude change, not political extremism.
Mostly because requires product performance to be the principal explanation for the claimed attitude changes.
Assess effects from the initial public rollout through the post date. Low usage, dissatisfaction and unwillingness to pay do not alone establish changed attitudes toward AI generally.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evidence identifies at least two million people whose attitudes toward AI became substantially more negative principally because of poor Apple Intelligence performance.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Adequately powered, representative causal evidence rules out an effect of that size or establishes that product performance was not its principal cause.

evidence.explanation: The detailed results combine respondents choosing 'not very valuable' with those choosing 'little to no value'; the headline should not be read as universal rejection. The survey measures perceived product value, not a change in attitudes toward AI caused by Apple.

evidence.excerpt: Distrust around AI’s ability to provide accurate information
evidence.explanation: June population polling is consistent with growing AI skepticism. It does not identify Apple Intelligence as the cause or count people whose attitudes changed because of its performance; available_at is a conservative latest-known publication bound.

This favorable survey finding challenges an inference of uniformly worsening reception. It does not exclude a negatively affected subgroup numbering millions and does not measure the claimed causal effect.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Representative longitudinal or causal research connecting product performance to changed general AI attitudes, with population counts and uncertainty.
